##### Project general facts

Iris Amber by SOL Living is a stylish residential project. A sub-product of SOL Properties Development, SOL Living is the ideal haven for wanderlust travellers, family getaways, and business travellers looking for a home away from home. Featuring fully furnished and stylish studios and one-bedroom apartments, each unit is designed with detailed craftsmanship, sophisticated and modern decor, and outstanding amenities catering to both leisure and business travellers.

Residents and guests can immerse into a fitness routine with a fully equipped gymnasium and swimming pool. Each apartment is equipped with top-notch amenities including a flat-screen TV, free WiFi, built-in wardrobes, full kitchen appliances, central air-conditioning, and high-class linens. Covered parking, 24/7 security, and maintenance are also provided, ensuring a comfortable and hassle-free stay.

Every unit at Iris Amber features sophisticated modern decor with detailed craftsmanship, creating spaces that are both stylish and welcoming. The fully furnished studios and one-bedroom apartments are equipped with state-of-the-art furniture to relax and unwind, with full kitchen appliances and high-class linens adding to the comfort. The thoughtful design and premium amenities make Iris Amber the perfect home away from home.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled along the historical Dubai Creek in the prime upcoming area of Jaddaf Waterfront, this exceptional location is where history, arts, and culture meet. Residents can explore and discover Al Jaddaf like a local, with the area offering a unique blend of heritage and modern development.

The location is distinguished by its excellent connectivity. While at Iris Amber, commuting around Dubai is made very easy with access to Al Khail Road and minutes away from the famous Sheikh Zayed Road, placing residents minutes away from anywhere they wish to go. The area's strategic positioning ensures seamless access to Dubai's key destinations.

For those seeking a residence that embodies style, convenience, and a prime Dubai address, Al Jaddaf delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of cultural richness, strategic connectivity, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living.
